name: Popcorn
notes:
Carries mobile subscriber traffic for Popcorn, a mobile network operator. All announced space is carrier-grade NAT egress for handsets.

Geofeed: https://static.popcorn.space/geofeed.csv
Reverse DNS: <ip>.<metro>.<cc>.cgnat.popcorn.space (e.g. 207-241-169-1.lhr.gb.cgnat.popcorn.space)

Abuse reports must include timestamp (UTC), source IP and source port.

Abuse: abuse-report@popcorn.space
NOC: support@popcorn.space
